title: 7.4.8 Check: Ship and shots
description: Six multiple-choice questions on keeping the ship on the canvas, the cooldown, removing shots, overlaps() and the playing gate. Checked instantly.

questions.question: `cooldown` is set to 12 after each shot. Holding Space for one second (60 frames) fires how many shots?
questions.explanation: One shot every 12 frames is 60 / 12 = 5 shots a second.

questions.question: What do `if (ship.x < 20) ship.x = 20;` and its partner do?
options: They keep the ship on the canvas
They slow the ship down near the edges
They stop the ship firing near a side
They end the round at an edge
questions.explanation: Whenever the ship goes past 20 or 380 it is put back on that line, so it can never leave the screen.

questions.question: A beat (`frameCount % 12 === 0`) and a cooldown both give a 12-frame gap. What can only the cooldown do?
options: Run more than once in a single frame
Count backwards past 0 and keep going below it
Keep running while the round is over and nothing moves
Start counting when something happens, such as a shot
questions.explanation: A beat ticks whether or not anything happened, while a cooldown is set at the moment of the shot, so the wait is always measured from the last shot.

questions.question: Why does `moveBullets()` loop from the end of `bullets` to the start?
options: Counting down is faster than counting up
A splice moves every later shot down one place, and going backwards none is skipped
Shots fly upwards, so the array has to be read from the top end
The newest shot must move first, or it would catch up with the one ahead
questions.explanation: Counting upwards, the shot that slides into the gap after a splice would be skipped; counting downwards, the shots still to visit never move.

questions.question: `overlaps()` is true on every frame a shot touches the drone. Why does one shot score only 1?
options: `overlaps()` is not true again until the shot has stopped touching
The drone has collider 'none', so a shot passes through it in one frame
The shot is deleted and spliced out on the frame it hits
The score can only go up by 1 on any one frame
questions.explanation: The shot is gone before the next frame, so there is no second frame on which it can overlap the drone.

questions.question: When `baseHp` reaches 0 the code sets `playing = false` and nothing else. Why does everything stop moving?
options: The base deletes every sprite on the canvas when its hp runs out
Every line that moves something is inside `if (playing)`
`playing = false` sets the world's gravity to 0
`drawTop()` stops drawing, and the sprites freeze with it
questions.explanation: Nothing in this game moves by itself, so once `playing` is false, `draw()` skips every line that moves the ship, the shots and the drone.
